name: Shaw's Report
summary: In Westfall, Shaw's Report carries confidential intelligence from SI:7 to Gryan Stoutmantle. Written by Master Mathias Shaw, it describes the Stonemasons Guild, Edwin VanCleef, and their grievance with the crown after Stormwind was rebuilt.

sections.title: Intelligence on the Stonemasons
sections.body: Shaw's Report reaches Sentinel Hill from SI:7's covert headquarters in Stormwind. The dispatch gives the People's Militia its first clear account of who commands the bandits ravaging Westfall. Under Edwin VanCleef, the Stonemasons Guild painstakingly rebuilt Stormwind City after its destruction in the First War. When the crown and nobility refused to pay the masons fairly for their work, resentment took root. Shaw's intelligence links the displaced craftsmen to the criminal uprising now seizing the kingdom's outer territories.

faq.answer: Shaw's Report is a sealed intelligence dossier compiled by Master Mathias Shaw, leader of Stormwind's covert SI:7 agency, for Gryan Stoutmantle. It contains the crown's intelligence on the Stonemasons Guild and Edwin VanCleef's history.

faq.q: What does the report reveal about Edwin VanCleef?
aliases: what does it say about vancleef
faq.answer: The report names Edwin VanCleef as the former head of the Stonemasons Guild, who oversaw Stormwind's reconstruction after the First War. It says he and his artisans revolted after the kingdom's rulers denied them proper payment.

faq.q: Why does Gryan Stoutmantle need this report?
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle needs the report because he leads the People's Militia against coordinated bandit raids in Westfall. With no regular kingdom troops to help, he relies on Mathias Shaw's intelligence to learn who directs the outlaws and what drives them.

faq.q: How does Stoutmantle react to the report?
faq.answer: The report leaves Gryan Stoutmantle deeply unsettled. He remembers Edwin VanCleef as an industrious, accomplished craftsman and struggles to believe such a respected builder turned villain without further proof.

angles.text: Shaw's Report shows the reach and methods of Master Mathias Shaw, leader of SI:7 and Stormwind's espionage network.
The report lays bare Stormwind's internal rot: an unpaid debt to the kingdom's architects helped spark an insurrection that threatens the realm's farmlands.
